prompt:
Theme:
Mid-air morning chaos

Subject:
A photorealistic moment in a sunlit living room where a woman in her 20s, a long-haired cat, and small objects around the furniture float in the air as if in zero gravity. The woman dives horizontally into the camera from the center of the screen, reaching forward with both hands. A white and brown cat is placed in the upper right, a coffee cup and splashing liquid in the lower right, a pink donut in the lower center, and an open book in the lower left.

Person/Expression:
Round oval face and small chin, large almond-shaped dark brown eyes, thin loose eyebrows, small nose tip, coral-colored lips wide open. Looking directly at the camera with a surprised expression and eyes wide open. Thin eyeliner, long eyelashes, peach cheeks. Light brown hair gathered in a messy bun near the crown, with thin bangs and a large amount of curled loose hair spreading in all directions as if gravity were lost.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory white fine-ribbed short-sleeved top, deep round neck, short tied style at the center under the chest, white lace edges visible inside. Soft pale pink shorts with fine frills at the waist and hem. The woman is in a posture of flying forward in the air while lying on her stomach, stretching both arms toward the camera, fingers wide open. Bend both knees behind, with the soles of bare feet pointing upward.

Background/Lighting:
A white sofa, a wooden round table, a large window with white lace curtains, a pale wooden floor, a shelf and small plants in the back right. The long-haired cat in the upper right has blue eyes, white fur, brown markings on the face and ears, a thick tail raised, and limbs extended forward floating in the air. Glasses, a black remote control, papers, cushions, and small potted plants are also scattered, and dark coffee and droplets arc from the white cup in the lower right. Warm direct morning light comes in from the window on the left, creating vivid highlights and soft shadows on the person, cat, and floor.

Composition/Camera:
15:19 vertical. A full-body action composition captured from the front by a wide-angle camera slightly higher than the floor. Place the woman's face in the center, large spread hands in the left and right foreground, and stretch bent legs into the top half with toes near the top edge. The cat is at the top right, the open book at the bottom left, the donut and cup at the bottom right, and floating objects are scattered to all four corners. Focus on the person's face and hands while maintaining a deep depth of field so that the main floating objects are clearly visible.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic live-action and CG composite expression in high-speed photography style. Sharply freeze skin, dancing hair, long cat fur, fabric, book paper, donut icing, and transparent splashes, neatly combining them with warm morning colors.

Negative:
Disappearance of the floating arrangement of person, cat, and small objects",
